seeds.vh-2-0-0-0: You step onto the swaying hemp bridges of the Rope Markets where merchants hawk greased tackle across a dizzying gorge.
seeds.vh-2-0-0-1: A winch-boy named Jory yells warnings from a creaking gantry above as heavy cargo baskets zip past your ears.
seeds.vh-2-0-0-2: You duck beneath an awning of hemp coils while the bronze Clapper hums softly against the cradle on your back.
seeds.vh-2-0-0-3: A Cable Court toll-house blocks the narrow plankway, demanding a bronze penny for every pound of suspended metal.
seeds.vh-2-0-1-0: You dodge a flying mail-skiff that screeches along a greasy iron cable above the roaring chasm.
seeds.vh-2-0-1-1: Old Garrow sells spliced strands of tarred flax while muttering about dishonest weigh-masters in the lower wards.
seeds.vh-2-0-1-2: A group of shivering winch-apprentices share roasted chestnuts over a brazier fueled by hemp shavings.
seeds.vh-2-0-1-3: You squeeze past a tangled heap of discarded rigging that threatens to trip Biscuit and the Clapper.
seeds.vh-2-0-1-4: A toll-lord's clerk wearing green spectacles taps his ledger and glares at your heavy cargo cradle.
seeds.vh-2-0-1-5: You slip down a damp salt-crusted stair where rope-scraps litter the boards like discarded snake skins.
seeds.vh-2-0-1-6: Biscuit drops his ears and nudges a hidden side-winch chute, bypassing the clogged toll-gate entirely with mule-savvy grace.
seeds.vh-2-0-1-7: A frantic rope-seller named Mara begs you to untangle a fouled winch-line before the evening gales hit.
seeds.vh-2-0-1-8: You balance on a narrow pine plank while a basket of salted char swings wildly past your ribs.
seeds.vh-2-0-1-9: A Cable Court guard weighs your pack on a groaning brass scale while his colleague eyes the bronze Clapper.
seeds.vh-2-0-2-0: You take shelter inside a hollow anchor-stone while an iron cable sings a high, piercing note in the wind.
seeds.vh-2-0-2-1: A one-eyed rope-master named Tallow inspects your backpack cradle with professional interest and a dry cough.
seeds.vh-2-0-2-2: You navigate a suspended market square where hundreds of hanks of yellow hemp flutter like prayer flags.
seeds.vh-2-0-2-3: A nervous clerk named Pip drops his tally-chalk as the bronze Clapper hums against your shoulder-straps.
seeds.vh-2-0-2-4: You step over a grease-slicked capstan while winch-hands heave in unison against the mountain draft.
seeds.vh-2-0-2-5: A stall selling dried mountain moss and tallow-dips offers a warm corner away from the biting gorge wind.
seeds.vh-2-0-2-6: You dodge a swinging counter-weight that crashes into the timber framing with a hollow, booming thud.
seeds.vh-2-0-2-7: An old cable-rider named Nesta warns you that the lower winches are jammed with frozen grease.
seeds.vh-2-0-2-8: You cross a trembling suspension bridge of twisted willow withes while the abyss yawns below your boots.
seeds.vh-2-0-2-9: A Cable Court inspector taps your bronze Clapper with a wooden rod to test its resonance and weight.
seeds.vh-2-0-2-10: You duck beneath a low canvas awning where weavers twist fibrous grass into unbreakable anchor-tethers.
seeds.vh-2-0-2-11: Your pristine Ropewrights' Guild tether earns an immediate nod from the gate-guards, who wave you past the toll-snarl.
seeds.vh-2-0-2-12: A frantic winch-boy drops his tallow bucket right across your path as a heavy basket screeches downward.
seeds.vh-2-0-3-0: You slip into a shadowy alcove behind a mountain-ash woodpile while toll-collectors argue over ledger tallies.
seeds.vh-2-0-3-1: A ropewright named Fenn offers you a cup of bitter chicory water to clear the mountain dust from your throat.
seeds.vh-2-0-3-2: You skirt the edge of a great timber wheel where greasy hemp cables hum with the tension of the cliff.
seeds.vh-2-0-3-3: A Cable Court sergeant blocks the alley with a spiked pole, demanding proof of your descent permit.
seeds.vh-2-0-3-4: You guide Biscuit past a pile of salted hides while the bronze Clapper vibrates against your tired spine.
seeds.vh-2-0-3-5: A weaver named Bram shows you a secret knot that secures heavy loads against the fiercest mountain downdrafts.
seeds.vh-2-0-3-6: You dash across an exposed platform of slatted pine while ice-pellets rattle against your canvas coat.
seeds.vh-2-0-3-7: The guard spots your braided guild-rope coil and instantly clears the winch-lane without demanding a single coin.
seeds.vh-2-0-3-8: A nervous merchant named Kael begs you to hide his smuggled tin wire beneath your bronze Clapper cradle.
seeds.vh-2-0-3-9: You climb a vertical series of wooden pegs hammered directly into the granite face above the bazaar.
seeds.vh-2-0-3-10: A toll-house window flies open and an irate clerk demands to know why your pack is humming so loudly.
seeds.vh-2-0-3-11: You squeeze through a narrow gap between two winch-shacks where the smell of warm pine tar fills the air.
seeds.vh-2-0-3-12: A gray-bearded capstan-master named Hake points a scarred finger toward the flickering lanterns of the lower market.
seeds.vh-2-0-4-0: You drop into a sheltered timber trench where rope-scraps deaden the howling roar of the mountain wind.
seeds.vh-2-0-4-1: A Cable Court runner brushes past you in the gloom, carrying urgent dispatches about the frozen pass gates.
seeds.vh-2-0-4-2: You navigate a web of crossed guy-lines that vibrate like harp strings in the rising evening gale.
seeds.vh-2-0-4-3: A ropewright's apprentice named Lyra holds a smoking tallow torch to light your footing across the slippery boards.
seeds.vh-2-0-4-4: You step around a massive iron winch-drum that groans as it lowers a cargo crate into the gray abyss.
seeds.vh-2-0-4-5: A toll-house lantern swings wildly overhead, casting long dancing shadows across your heavy bronze burden.
seeds.vh-2-0-4-6: You follow a narrow ledge of packed snow past the rear wall of the upper rope-spinning lofts.
seeds.vh-2-0-4-7: A weary guard leans against a wooden post, pointing you toward the flickering lanterns of the guild stalls.
seeds.vh-2-0-5-0: You approach the glowing canvas pavilion of the Knot-Oath Stall where master ropewrights wait by the main cable hub.
seeds.vh-2-0-5-1: The master of the Knot-Oath Stall steps out from hemp curtains, offering safe passage in exchange for a binding promise.
seeds.vh-2-0-5-2: You halt before the guild's central counter where a knotted hemp cord hangs like a judge's scale in the lamplight.
seeds.vh-2-0-5-3: The chief rope-master blocks your path with an outstretched cord, demanding your knot-oath before you descend any further.
